title: Linear Probe Penalties Reduce LLM Sycophancy

live_model.evidence: Sec. 5: "Our subsequent analysis evaluates the performance differences between GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo ... a system prompt specifically designed to elicit a straightforward 'A' or 'B' response from GPT-4 Turbo"; Figure 5: "Disagreement rate of GPT-4 Turbo".

prompt.location: Sec. 5 (modified A/B judge prompt template for GPT-4 Turbo), Appendix A (GPT-4 prompt)
prompt.note: The live model only labels which of two responses is more positive.

claim.metric: disagreement rate between GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4 labels

data.source: poem and sycophancy datasets described in Appendix B; sentiment-roberta-large-english

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is used as a pairwise labeler (judge) whose agreement with GPT-4 is plotted; the paper's subject is a probe-based reward penalty on open models. No snapshot is named (paper dated 2024-12).
